# PayXa

> PayXa is an India-focused UPI payment automation, hosted checkout, and merchant payment reconciliation software platform developed by CodeXa Agency.

Official Website: https://payxa.in
Entity Name: PayXa
Parent Developer: CodeXa Agency
Category: UPI Payment Automation & Reconciliation Software
Market: India (INR currency, UPI payments)

## Core Capabilities
- Direct-to-merchant UPI checkout: Funds flow directly into the merchant's eligible bank/VPA account without intermediary pooling.
- Instant merchant phone alerts: Dispatches payment-started push notifications to registered merchant Android devices upon checkout creation.
- Notification & source reconciliation: Correlates checkout sessions with incoming bank/PSP credit alerts.
- Developer API & Webhooks: Idempotent order creation, signed webhook dispatches (`payment.verified`, `payment.failed`, `order.expired`), and JavaScript checkout SDK.

- [Hosted UPI Checkout](https://payxa.in/products/checkout): Real-time QR and UPI deep-linking checkout experience.
- [Payment Links](https://payxa.in/products/payment-links): Shareable payment links with configurable expiration and automatic customer receipts.
- [QR Payments](https://payxa.in/products/qr-payments): Dynamic and printable static UPI QR payment standees.
- [Instant Alerts](https://payxa.in/products/instant-alerts): Instant phone notification mechanism for checkout events.

- [Developer Hub](https://payxa.in/developers): Technical guide for integrating PayXa into websites and applications.
- [API Documentation](https://payxa.in/docs): API v1 reference, curl examples, idempotency keys, and webhook signatures.

- [Pricing](https://payxa.in/pricing): Proposed V1 Free Starter tier with ₹0 platform fee.
- [Security & Architecture](https://payxa.in/security): Direct fund routing, device security, token hashing, and privacy model.
- [Merchant Android App](https://payxa.in/download): Official PayXa Merchant companion app for Android.

## What PayXa Never Does
- PayXa does not hold, pool, or settle customer funds.
- PayXa does not replace RBI-regulated banks or payment aggregators; it operates as an automation and reconciliation layer.
- PayXa does not take a percentage cut of customer payment transactions.
